messages:
maya: Nightly eval flagged pset v2.3 as a regression after the promptset bump. Rerank +2 token cost but accuracy dropped, and we have more hallucinations. tagging @jordan for the prompt diff that went out last night.

eval-bot: Nightly summary: pset_v2.3 — 14/120 failing cases. pass_rate 85.8% -> 82.1% (-3.7). hallucination_rate 2.1% -> 4.9% (+2.8). Full artifact: https://internal/reports/nightly/1719994321 (private).

jordan: yup that was my change — tiny phrasing tweak in the 'ask_for_context' template to try reduce clarifying Qs. rolling back locally to confirm.

sam: can you paste the exact diff?

jordan: here — small snippet from the prompt file: 
```diff
@@ templates/ask_for_context.tpl
-"Please share any relevant context or details so I can help."
+"Give the model the context it needs to answer; include relevant details."
```

liz: hmm that moves from a soft invitation to an instruction. could cause model to assume more and stop asking clarifying Qs, which would increase hallucination on ambiguous queries.

maya: agree. we need to decide revert vs rebaseline. immediate mitigation: revert on canary and re-eval. longer term: stricter review for wording changes. also need to check quantized variants — sometimes phrasing interacts with quantization.

jordan: quick results from my local reruns: swapped back to v2.2 prompt text -> pass_rate back to 85.9%. with v2.3 text it stays ~82.0. ran on both fp16-quant and float32 — direction is same. so it's causal.

sam: ouch. was this change behind a formal prompt PR? i remember it landed as a small edit. we lack a "minor wording" gating.

maya: for process: revert canary now, open a PR with the problematic text and include: 1) diff 2) per-bucket eval (12 failure cases) 3) suggested alternative variants (soft rephrase) 4) A/B plan. Require QA signoff before rebaseline.

liz: i'll run manual inspection on the 12 failing examples and post notes in the PR. if the change improves clarifying question rate without dropping correctness on the critical buckets, i can approve. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Canary rollback triggered by maya at 2024-09-12T03:00:00Z — rolling back pset to v2.2 on canary nodes.

jordan: i'll open the PR now with two variants: (A) original (v2.2), (B) soft-rephrase that keeps invitation language: 
```
"If you can, please share any relevant context or details so I can help best."
```
plus (C) a variant with explicit anchor examples. will attach per-variant eval graphs.

maya: thanks. checklist for follow-up: revert canary (done), PR with eval artifacts, liz QA notes, then decide rebaseline only if no regression on the 12 critical buckets (and ideally +0.2% overall).

sam: do we want to add an automated zap in the CI to require "no-regression" flag for prompt edits that touch templates/ask_for_context.tpl?

jordan: good idea. i can add a lint that flags edits to core templates and requires a short eval stub commit.

maya: let's do that. for now, i'll post a heads-up in #evals-daily and cc product and support in case customers saw noise. thanks all.

(deploy-bot reaction: :white_check_mark:)
